proposed_widenings.name: replace_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive rider changes the damage type of an existing weapon hit without changing its amount or attack resolution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The Lightning Bolt activation deterministically restores the thrown item to the wielder's hand after its save-gated damage resolves.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: The Lightning Bolt activation subset compiles, typechecks, and traces cleanly. Classification remains atom_widening because the passive damage-type swap and the deterministic return-to-hand rider are both outside the current atom surface.
